CustomObject.label: DealPilot Setting
CustomObject.description: Configurable base URL for the ADK backend DealPilotAgentController calls. Repointing it (an ngrok tunnel to a local SALESFORCE_MODE=live instance, or a future live-mode Cloud Run deployment) is a metadata/data update, never an Apex code change — see salesforce-metadata/README.md's "DealPilot Agent LWC" section.
